rasterLayout: rf-rasters.webp (greyscale, black = spike): per presentation a strip of 1-px rows, one per unit in presentations[p].units order, at column at[0] (x = at[0] * rasterWidth) and row at[1]; presentations[p].fields = the receptive fields decodable in some step of p, top to bottom on screen; draw each field's members (rf-decoders) as one block, in that order
fields: per step, entryStart[step]..entryStart[step + 1]: the receptive fields the ridge can decode in that window (eligible and fully on screen, as the paper): gid, centre (x10), spikes; default = the most spikes
errorNote: per step, the default field's 8-bit RGB MSE against the photograph (clicks only); -1: no decodable field
gate: browser decoder vs paper pipeline, max 8-bit difference over every field of every step: 1
